title: The Other Window
summary: Write one scene through three pairs of eyes, then change the reading order to see how each account shapes the next.
summaryZhTW: 從三個人的角度書寫同一幕，再調整閱讀順序，看看前一段敘述如何改變你對下一段的理解。
controls: Choose a shared moment and switch narrators, adapt the Taipei bus story, or start a notebook. Find another angle offers a prompt for rewriting your passage.
limitations: Drafts are saved in the current browser. Use JSON export and import to move a notebook between devices.

approval.note: GitHub Pages published the bilingual writing studio on November 14, 2026.
